Package neqsim.process.operations.continuous

Class ModelDriftMonitor

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.continuous.ModelDriftMonitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ModelDriftMonitor extends Object implements Serializable
EWMA and two-sided CUSUM drift monitor for named scalar signals with a frozen warm-up baseline.

The first warmup values of each signal fix its baseline mean and standard deviation. After that, each value updates an exponentially weighted moving average (started at the baseline mean) and a standardised two-sided CUSUM. An alarm needs confirm consecutive out-of-control values. An engineering floor on the standard deviation (minSigma) suppresses shifts that are statistically real but too small to be worth a review; without it a short warm-up underestimates the noise and white noise alone raises false alarms within months.

This is the Java counterpart of the neqsim_continuous.drift.DriftMonitor used by living tasks, so a Java or MCP client gets identical alarms from identical data.

1.0
